svg.text: NEMA14 CH32X035G8U6 | Status, Temperature & Audible Alarm
A4 landscape | 4 / 4 | Named nets connect across sheets | NC = intentionally unused pin

text.tspan: D_STATUS + 1k R_LED: active-low MCU status indicator.
Power-up input/high = off; low = on. Verify visibility.
Reports local PCB temperature, not measured motor/winding temperature.
MLT-5020 sounder: external PWM near 4 kHz; default OFF.
AO3400A low-side switch; 100 ohm gate + 100k pull-down.
1N5819WS flyback clamp + 22uF bypass. Acoustic/current tests pending.
